اختصموا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَصَمُوا (iḵtaṣamū) /ix.ta.sˤa.muː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِخْتَصَمَ (iḵtaṣama)
# اِخْتَصِمُوا (iḵtaṣimū) /ix.ta.sˤi.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِخْتَصَمَ (iḵtaṣama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
